task: 深挖 DSH AGENTS.md + tool pipeline 守卫实现(源码级)
method: GitHub API 一手拉取:AGENTS.md全文192行/pipeline文档66行 + 源码7文件1722行(pipeline.ts807/contracts.ts418/tools_index.ts/guard_repeat.ts/guard_timeout.ts/fork_tool_guard.ts/fork_enforcement.ts/creation_rec.ts) + 代码搜索tools.guard(21处)

agents_md_findings.finding: AGENTS.md 192行是仓库给agent的治理宪法:改packages/前必读architecture.md;Public API pre-stable必须更新所有consumer;SQLite用monotonic SCHEMA_VERSION;committed generation只增不覆盖不删除;前序版本不隐含fallback/downgrade支持
agents_md_findings.maps_to: 内核'历史事实不可动/补判不可回填'同构——released session格式只加version-named successor,never move/overwrite/delete committed generations
Cordis reversibility,与内核只读探针'不写盘不消费'对偶

agents_md_findings.finding: Model-visible ⟺ logged:到达模型请求的任何东西都必须可从session log重建;新model-visible输入必须有session event
agents_md_findings.maps_to: 内核'每个verdict须有判定权归属锚点否则=伪装成信息的噪音'同构

agents_md_findings.finding: Waterfall listeners MUST call next()否则短路链;Plugins not loop changes;No hardcoded tunables in plugins;Misconfiguration fails loud
agents_md_findings.maps_to: 管线不可绕过/失败响亮,与内核'不静默降级/不伪造裁定'同构

agents_md_findings.finding: test:coverage才是CI coverage gate(per-file 100% on packages/*/*/src),不是test;Never default to full suite;Coverage是门但只覆盖src表面
agents_md_findings.maps_to: 与内核'测试绿≠真相已验证'同构——100% coverage只是结构门,不保证行为真对

agents_md_findings.finding: Host sandbox failures:凭据/网络/IPC被沙箱阻断时用最窄host escalation重试,但'Require sandbox evidence; never bypass test failures or the product sandbox'
agents_md_findings.maps_to: 与DSH SAFETY.md'分层降风险不保证隔离'一致:升级通道存在但有证据纪律约束

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: ToolGuard单调性精确定义(contracts.ts:403-410):'Returning a reason denies the call; returning undefined leaves it unchanged. Because guards have no allow result, listener ordering cannot turn a denial back into permission.'——守卫只有deny或abstain,没有allow,所以顺序无法把拒绝翻成允许
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 这是'单调'的代码级定义,比书/文档的'Guard要单调'精确得多

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: checkGuards实现(index.ts:394-402):遍历[global,...chainLayers(agent)],第一个denial即返回;guard返回string转{reason},或ToolGuardDenial带结构化info;全undefined才放行
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: first-denial-wins,无overrides通道——结构上不存在'后来者翻案'

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 管线顺序(pipeline.ts prepare 191-235):tools/pre-execute waterfall→ask则serviceAsk→decision.kind==='allow'才checkGuards→denial即materializeFinalResult(isError=true)→dispatch。deny/cancel/ask-refused都跳过tool body;approvalCancelled且callerCancelled→post-result abort
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 文档图的mermaid顺序在源码逐行坐实

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: approval降级为deny(pipeline.ts:442-492):ctx.get('approval')没有→APPROVAL_UNAVAILABLE deny;无agent路由→deny;outcome allowed-once放行,rejected/cancelled/unavailable全deny且带ApprovalError identity;assertNever兜底
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: '拿不到答复就拒绝'一手坐实;deployment不组合ApprovalService时degrade to deny不是degrade to allow

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: frozen authoritative outcome(pipeline.ts:611/693):'Materialize the authoritative commit outcome once, immediately before tools/result';snapshot freeze lossless JSON,lossy则reject;'tools/result then observes the immutable, lossless-JSON outcome'
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 冻结的权威结果=内核'权威态零副作用'同构,且明确lossy数据宁可拒绝也不静默丢失

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 关键分类纠正:packages/guard/下两个包并非单调拒绝守卫!repeat-tool-reminder源码自述'Advisory...enriches post-execute decisions with logged model context without vetoing or rewriting calls'(顾问式,不否决);timeout-policy是'Cooperative...wrapper arms deadline'(合作式包装)。真正的ToolGuard单调守卫注册点是ctx.tools.guard(),代码搜索21处
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 诚实纠偏:若按目录名'guard/'就断定是单调守卫会误判;真实单调守卫在extension/experimental里

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 真实单调守卫范例1(fork_tool_guard.ts:102-180):decideForkToolUse——tool不在host installed→deny(fork-tool-not-permitted);paths无法established→deny(fork-paths-unknown);paths空且非noFileEffect→deny;path越出granted workspace→deny;未知一律拒绝,绝不'未知当空/未知当允许'。注释:'an unknown path set is refused rather than treated as empty'
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 与内核'脏key原样暴露不静默解析/verdict None不当噪音'同构——未知即拒绝是同一纪律

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 真实单调守卫范例2(fork_tool_guard.ts:31-38):token是runtime给每次执行的symbol handle,'The model-facing callId is caller-supplied and reusable, so a verdict keyed on it could be replayed by another call; this token is the runtime's own handle for exactly one execution'
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: 防replay:判定不能绑在可复用的caller id上,要绑runtime唯一token——与内核'判定权归属锚点不可自填/woken_by不可自填'同构

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 真实单调守卫范例3(fork_enforcement.ts):'the monotonic guard that refuses whatever the verdict did not confirm';scope注册失败→guard仍安装且名字被refused而非用owner工具serve;scope-registered shadow以不同definition应答→refused;view-only tier不装write replacement→guard拒绝该名字
pipeline_guard_source_findings.significance: registrations as effects+失败响亮+不静默降级,三原则在一处汇合

pipeline_guard_source_findings.finding: 真实单调守卫范例4(creation_rec.ts:127-131):ctx.tools.guard((exec)=>{非creator agent/非plugin_manager/白名单list动作→return undefined(abstain);creator下→return拒绝原因字符串})
